library.name: openUsdPhysics
library.doc: Project-owned physics extensions. Codeless: authoring and validation work against a stock OpenUSD runtime with no compiled schema library.

precedence.description: Project-owned OpenUsdPhysics schema. Strongest opinion and the only namespace this repository defines.

Foreign physx* opinions authored by other tools. Treated as an optional raw input that is read when present and never required. No PhysxSchema definitions are vendored; see schemas/third-party/physxSchema/PROVENANCE.md.
Standard UsdPhysics schema shipped with OpenUSD. Weakest opinion.

gaps.reason: Covered by OpenUsdPhysicsFixedTendon, OpenUsdPhysicsSpatialTendon, and OpenUsdPhysicsTendonAttachmentAPI.

Covered by OpenUsdPhysicsParticleSystemAPI, OpenUsdPhysicsParticleSetAPI, OpenUsdPhysicsParticleClothAPI, OpenUsdPhysicsPbdMaterialAPI, OpenUsdPhysicsDiffuseParticlesAPI, OpenUsdPhysicsParticleAnisotropyAPI, OpenUsdPhysicsParticleSmoothingAPI, and OpenUsdPhysicsParticleIsosurfaceAPI.
Covered by OpenUsdPhysicsCookedDataAPI. The schema references cooked data produced at build time and never embeds it.
Covered by OpenUsdPhysicsSceneAPI, OpenUsdPhysicsRigidBodySettingsAPI, OpenUsdPhysicsCollisionSettingsAPI, OpenUsdPhysicsMaterialSettingsAPI, and OpenUsdPhysicsArticulationSettingsAPI.

Every class is single-apply so that each property keeps the flat 'openUsdPhysics:<group>:<name>' shape the precedence rule depends on. Domains that need several instances on one object are modelled as concrete prims instead.

classes.name: OpenUsdPhysicsSceneAPI
classes.doc: Solver and stepping settings that the standard UsdPhysicsScene schema does not express. Apply to a PhysicsScene prim.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:scene:solverType
properties.doc: Constraint solver to use for this scene.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:scene:positionIterationCount
properties.doc: Solver position iterations per simulation step.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:scene:velocityIterationCount
properties.doc: Solver velocity iterations per simulation step.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:scene:timeStepsPerSecond
properties.doc: Requested fixed simulation frequency. The session clamps this to the supported range and reports a diagnostic when it does.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:scene:maxSubStepCount
properties.doc: Maximum fixed steps consumed for one transport tick before playback slows down instead of dropping steps.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:scene:broadPhaseType
properties.doc: Broad-phase algorithm to use for this scene.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:scene:frictionType
properties.doc: Friction model used when resolving contacts.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:scene:enableCCD
properties.doc: Enables continuous collision detection for the whole scene.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:scene:enableStabilization
properties.doc: Enables the solver stabilization pass.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:scene:enableEnhancedDeterminism
properties.doc: Requests additional ordering guarantees at a performance cost.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:scene:bounceThreshold
properties.doc: Relative normal speed below which contacts do not bounce, in stage linear units per second.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:scene:frictionOffsetThreshold
properties.doc: Contact separation above which friction anchors are discarded, in stage linear units.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:scene:frictionCorrelationDistance
properties.doc: Distance used to merge friction anchors, in stage linear units.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:scene:maxBiasCoefficient
properties.doc: Upper bound on the solver penetration bias coefficient.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:scene:gpuRequestMode
properties.doc: How the session should treat optional GPU acceleration. 'required' turns an unavailable capability into a build failure instead of a per-object diagnostic.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:scene:reportContacts
properties.doc: Enables scene-wide contact event collection.

classes.name: OpenUsdPhysicsRigidBodySettingsAPI
classes.doc: Per-body solver settings that standard UsdPhysicsRigidBodyAPI does not express. Apply alongside PhysicsRigidBodyAPI.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:body:positionIterationCount
properties.doc: Solver position iterations for this body. Overrides the scene value.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:body:velocityIterationCount
properties.doc: Solver velocity iterations for this body. Overrides the scene value.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:body:sleepThreshold
properties.doc: Mass-normalized kinetic energy below which the body may sleep.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:body:stabilizationThreshold
properties.doc: Mass-normalized kinetic energy below which the stabilization pass engages.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:body:maxLinearVelocity
properties.doc: Linear velocity clamp in stage linear units per second.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:body:maxAngularVelocity
properties.doc: Angular velocity clamp in degrees per second.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:body:maxDepenetrationVelocity
properties.doc: Upper bound on the velocity the solver may apply to resolve penetration.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:body:maxContactImpulse
properties.doc: Upper bound on the impulse a single contact may apply.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:body:contactSlopCoefficient
properties.doc: Penetration tolerance retained to reduce jitter, in stage linear units.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:body:enableCCD
properties.doc: Enables continuous collision detection for this body.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:body:enableSpeculativeCCD
properties.doc: Enables speculative contacts for this body.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:body:disableGravity
properties.doc: Excludes this body from scene gravity.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:body:retainAccelerations
properties.doc: Keeps solver accelerations between steps.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:body:lockedLinearAxes
properties.doc: Translation axes the solver must not move. Valid entries are 'x', 'y', and 'z' in stage space.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:body:lockedAngularAxes
properties.doc: Rotation axes the solver must not move. Valid entries are 'x', 'y', and 'z' in stage space.

classes.name: OpenUsdPhysicsCollisionSettingsAPI
classes.doc: Per-collider tolerances and reporting that standard UsdPhysicsCollisionAPI does not express.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:collision:contactOffset
properties.doc: Distance at which contacts are generated, in stage linear units. A negative value requests the runtime default.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:collision:restOffset
properties.doc: Separation maintained at rest, in stage linear units.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:collision:torsionalPatchRadius
properties.doc: Radius used to derive torsional friction for patch contacts, in stage linear units.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:collision:minTorsionalPatchRadius
properties.doc: Lower bound applied to the torsional patch radius, in stage linear units.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:collision:reportContacts
properties.doc: Emits contact events for this collider.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:collision:contactImpulseThreshold
properties.doc: Minimum impulse a contact must carry before it is reported as an event.

classes.name: OpenUsdPhysicsMaterialSettingsAPI
classes.doc: Material combine modes and compliant-contact settings that standard UsdPhysicsMaterialAPI does not express.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:material:frictionCombineMode
properties.doc: How friction coefficients of two contacting materials combine.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:material:restitutionCombineMode
properties.doc: How restitution coefficients of two contacting materials combine.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:material:compliantContactStiffness
properties.doc: Contact spring stiffness. Zero selects rigid contacts.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:material:compliantContactDamping
properties.doc: Contact spring damping. Ignored when the stiffness is zero.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:material:improvePatchFriction
properties.doc: Uses the improved patch friction model for this material.

classes.name: OpenUsdPhysicsArticulationSettingsAPI
classes.doc: Reduced-coordinate articulation settings that standard UsdPhysicsArticulationRootAPI does not express.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:articulation:positionIterationCount
properties.doc: Solver position iterations for the articulation.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:articulation:velocityIterationCount
properties.doc: Solver velocity iterations for the articulation.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:articulation:sleepThreshold
properties.doc: Mass-normalized kinetic energy below which the articulation may sleep.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:articulation:stabilizationThreshold
properties.doc: Mass-normalized kinetic energy below which the stabilization pass engages.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:articulation:enabledSelfCollisions
properties.doc: Allows links of the same articulation to collide with each other.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:articulation:fixBase
properties.doc: Anchors the articulation root to the world.

classes.name: OpenUsdPhysicsSimulationMetadataAPI
classes.doc: Stable simulation identity and provenance recorded on a physics object so results, events, and queries can be correlated across rebuilds.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:simulation:schemaVersion
properties.doc: Version of the openUsdPhysics schema the opinions on this prim were authored against.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:simulation:identity
properties.doc: Stable signed 64-bit simulation identity. Zero requests a derived identity from the canonical prim path and instance domain.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:simulation:identityDomain
properties.doc: Addressing domain the identity index applies to.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:simulation:identityIndex
properties.doc: Index within the identity domain. -1 addresses the prim itself.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:simulation:sourceRevision
properties.doc: Opaque revision recorded when these opinions were produced by a bake or an export.

classes.name: OpenUsdPhysicsCharacterControllerAPI
classes.doc: A kinematic character controller. Apply to a UsdGeomXformable prim. The controller is driven by session move commands, not by authored per-frame input.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:controller:enabled
properties.doc: Enables the controller.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:controller:shapeType
properties.doc: Controller volume. 'halfExtents' applies to boxes; 'radius' and 'height' apply to capsules.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:controller:radius
properties.doc: Capsule radius in stage linear units.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:controller:height
properties.doc: Capsule segment height, excluding the caps, in stage linear units.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:controller:halfExtents
properties.doc: Box half extents in stage linear units.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:controller:upAxis
properties.doc: Controller up direction in stage space. A zero vector requests the stage upAxis.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:controller:contactOffset
properties.doc: Skin width kept between the controller and geometry, in stage linear units.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:controller:stepOffset
properties.doc: Maximum obstacle height the controller can climb, in stage linear units.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:controller:slopeLimit
properties.doc: Maximum walkable slope in degrees, measured from the up axis.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:controller:nonWalkableMode
properties.doc: Behaviour when the controller meets a surface steeper than the slope limit.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:controller:climbingMode
properties.doc: Capsule climbing behaviour. Ignored for box controllers.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:controller:invisibleWallHeight
properties.doc: Height of the virtual wall added above non-walkable surfaces, in stage linear units. Zero disables it.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:controller:maxJumpHeight
properties.doc: Height above the controller kept clear when invisible walls are enabled, in stage linear units.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:controller:minMoveDistance
properties.doc: Move requests shorter than this distance are discarded, in stage linear units.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:controller:volumeGrowth
properties.doc: Cache volume growth factor used when gathering nearby geometry.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:controller:scaleCoeff
properties.doc: Scale applied to the controller volume when generating its collision proxy.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:controller:density
properties.doc: Density of the controller kinematic proxy, in stage mass units per cubic linear unit.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:controller:material
properties.doc: Single physics material applied to the controller volume.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:controller:simulationOwner
properties.doc: Single PhysicsScene that simulates this controller.

classes.name: OpenUsdPhysicsVehicleAPI
classes.doc: Marks a rigid body as a vehicle. Apply alongside PhysicsRigidBodyAPI. Wheels are described by descendant prims carrying OpenUsdPhysicsVehicleWheelAttachmentAPI.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:vehicle:enabled
properties.doc: Enables vehicle simulation for this body.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:vehicle:driveType
properties.doc: Drivetrain model. 'none' simulates suspension and tires only, 'direct' applies wheel torques directly, and 'engine' uses the engine, clutch, gearbox, and differential.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:vehicle:suspensionQueryType
properties.doc: Scene query used to find the ground under each wheel.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:vehicle:longitudinalAxis
properties.doc: Forward axis of the vehicle in its own body space.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:vehicle:lateralAxis
properties.doc: Right axis of the vehicle in its own body space.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:vehicle:verticalAxis
properties.doc: Up axis of the vehicle in its own body space.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:vehicle:minPassiveLongitudinalSlipDenominator
properties.doc: Lower bound on the longitudinal slip denominator while no drive torque is applied, in stage linear units per second.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:vehicle:minActiveLongitudinalSlipDenominator
properties.doc: Lower bound on the longitudinal slip denominator while drive torque is applied, in stage linear units per second.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:vehicle:minLateralSlipDenominator
properties.doc: Lower bound on the lateral slip denominator, in stage linear units per second.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:vehicle:longitudinalStickyTireThresholdSpeed
properties.doc: Longitudinal speed below which the sticky tire constraint may engage, in stage linear units per second.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:vehicle:longitudinalStickyTireThresholdTime
properties.doc: Time the longitudinal speed must stay below the threshold before the sticky tire constraint engages, in seconds.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:vehicle:longitudinalStickyTireDamping
properties.doc: Damping of the longitudinal sticky tire constraint.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:vehicle:lateralStickyTireThresholdSpeed
properties.doc: Lateral speed below which the sticky tire constraint may engage, in stage linear units per second.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:vehicle:lateralStickyTireThresholdTime
properties.doc: Time the lateral speed must stay below the threshold before the sticky tire constraint engages, in seconds.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:vehicle:lateralStickyTireDamping
properties.doc: Damping of the lateral sticky tire constraint.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:vehicle:subStepCountLowSpeed
properties.doc: Vehicle sub-steps per simulation step below the longitudinal speed threshold.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:vehicle:subStepCountHighSpeed
properties.doc: Vehicle sub-steps per simulation step at or above the longitudinal speed threshold.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:vehicle:subStepThresholdLongitudinalSpeed
properties.doc: Longitudinal speed separating the low- and high-speed sub-step counts, in stage linear units per second.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:vehicle:drivetrain
properties.doc: Single prim carrying the engine, clutch, gearbox, and differential schemas for this vehicle. When absent, those schemas are looked up on the vehicle prim itself.

classes.name: OpenUsdPhysicsVehicleWheelAttachmentAPI
classes.doc: Attaches one wheel to a vehicle. Apply to a descendant prim of the vehicle body.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:wheelAttachment:index
properties.doc: Wheel index referenced by the brake, steering, and differential wheel lists. -1 requests an index derived from traversal order.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:wheelAttachment:suspensionFramePosition
properties.doc: Suspension frame origin in vehicle body space, in stage linear units.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:wheelAttachment:suspensionFrameOrientation
properties.doc: Suspension frame orientation in vehicle body space as a unit quaternion ordered (w, x, y, z).

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:wheelAttachment:suspensionTravelDirection
properties.doc: Direction the suspension compresses along, in vehicle body space.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:wheelAttachment:wheelFramePosition
properties.doc: Wheel centre offset from the suspension frame at maximum droop, in stage linear units.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:wheelAttachment:wheelFrameOrientation
properties.doc: Wheel orientation relative to the suspension frame as a unit quaternion ordered (w, x, y, z).

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:wheelAttachment:wheel
properties.doc: Single prim carrying OpenUsdPhysicsVehicleWheelAPI. When absent, the schema is looked up on this prim.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:wheelAttachment:tire
properties.doc: Single prim carrying OpenUsdPhysicsVehicleTireAPI. When absent, the schema is looked up on this prim.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:wheelAttachment:suspension
properties.doc: Single prim carrying OpenUsdPhysicsVehicleSuspensionAPI. When absent, the schema is looked up on this prim.

classes.name: OpenUsdPhysicsVehicleWheelAPI
classes.doc: Rotating wheel mass properties for a vehicle wheel.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:wheel:radius
properties.doc: Wheel radius in stage linear units.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:wheel:width
properties.doc: Wheel width in stage linear units.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:wheel:mass
properties.doc: Wheel mass in stage mass units.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:wheel:momentOfInertia
properties.doc: Wheel moment of inertia about its rotation axis.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:wheel:dampingRate
properties.doc: Damping applied to the wheel rotation speed.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:wheel:toeAngle
properties.doc: Static toe angle in degrees.

classes.name: OpenUsdPhysicsVehicleSuspensionAPI
classes.doc: Suspension spring and camber compliance for a vehicle wheel.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:suspension:springStrength
properties.doc: Suspension spring stiffness.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:suspension:springDamperRate
properties.doc: Suspension damping rate.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:suspension:travelDistance
properties.doc: Total suspension travel from maximum droop to maximum compression, in stage linear units.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:suspension:sprungMass
properties.doc: Mass carried by this suspension in stage mass units. Zero requests a distribution derived from the vehicle mass and wheel placement.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:suspension:camberAtRest
properties.doc: Camber angle in degrees at the rest position.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:suspension:camberAtMaxCompression
properties.doc: Camber angle in degrees at maximum compression.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:suspension:camberAtMaxDroop
properties.doc: Camber angle in degrees at maximum droop.

classes.name: OpenUsdPhysicsVehicleTireAPI
classes.doc: Tire force response for a vehicle wheel.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:tire:longitudinalStiffness
properties.doc: Longitudinal force per unit longitudinal slip.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:tire:lateralStiffnessGraph
properties.doc: Lateral stiffness response as (normalized load, stiffness) pairs in ascending load order.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:tire:camberStiffness
properties.doc: Lateral force per unit camber angle in degrees.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:tire:restLoad
properties.doc: Load carried by the tire at rest. Zero requests a value derived from the sprung mass and scene gravity.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:tire:frictionVsSlipGraph
properties.doc: Friction multiplier as (longitudinal slip, multiplier) pairs in ascending slip order.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:tire:frictionTable
properties.doc: Single OpenUsdPhysicsVehicleTireFrictionTable prim selecting friction by ground material.

classes.name: OpenUsdPhysicsVehicleTireFrictionTable
classes.doc: Maps ground physics materials to tire friction values. Referenced by OpenUsdPhysicsVehicleTireAPI.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:frictionTable:defaultFrictionValue
properties.doc: Friction used for ground materials that the table does not list.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:frictionTable:frictionValues
properties.doc: Friction value per entry of the ground materials relationship, in the same order.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:frictionTable:groundMaterials
properties.doc: Ordered ground physics materials the friction values apply to.

classes.name: OpenUsdPhysicsVehicleEngineAPI
classes.doc: Engine model for a vehicle whose drive type is 'engine'.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:engine:momentOfInertia
properties.doc: Engine moment of inertia about its rotation axis.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:engine:peakTorque
properties.doc: Maximum torque the engine can deliver.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:engine:maxRotationSpeed
properties.doc: Maximum engine rotation speed in radians per second.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:engine:idleRotationSpeed
properties.doc: Idle engine rotation speed in radians per second.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:engine:torqueCurve
properties.doc: Torque multiplier as (normalized rotation speed, multiplier) pairs in ascending speed order.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:engine:dampingRateFullThrottle
properties.doc: Engine damping at full throttle.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:engine:dampingRateZeroThrottleClutchEngaged
properties.displayName: Damping Rate Zero Throttle Clutch Engaged
properties.doc: Engine damping at zero throttle with the clutch engaged.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:engine:dampingRateZeroThrottleClutchDisengaged
properties.displayName: Damping Rate Zero Throttle Clutch Disengaged
properties.doc: Engine damping at zero throttle with the clutch disengaged.

classes.name: OpenUsdPhysicsVehicleGearsAPI
classes.doc: Gearbox ratios for a vehicle whose drive type is 'engine'.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:gears:ratios
properties.doc: Gear ratios in gear order, starting with reverse and neutral.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:gears:ratioScale
properties.doc: Scale applied to every gear ratio.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:gears:switchTime
properties.doc: Time taken to change gear, in seconds.

classes.name: OpenUsdPhysicsVehicleAutoGearBoxAPI
classes.doc: Automatic transmission thresholds. Requires OpenUsdPhysicsVehicleGearsAPI on the same prim.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:autoGearBox:upRatios
properties.doc: Normalized engine speed above which the transmission shifts up, per forward gear.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:autoGearBox:downRatios
properties.doc: Normalized engine speed below which the transmission shifts down, per forward gear.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:autoGearBox:latency
properties.doc: Minimum time between automatic gear changes, in seconds.

classes.name: OpenUsdPhysicsVehicleClutchAPI
classes.doc: Clutch model for a vehicle whose drive type is 'engine'.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:clutch:strength
properties.doc: Clutch coupling strength.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:clutch:accuracyMode
properties.doc: Accuracy of the drivetrain solve.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:clutch:estimateIterations
properties.doc: Iterations used when the accuracy mode is 'estimate'.

classes.name: OpenUsdPhysicsVehicleDifferentialAPI
classes.doc: Distributes drive torque across the driven wheels of a vehicle.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:differential:wheels
properties.doc: Indices of the driven wheels.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:differential:torqueRatios
properties.doc: Fraction of drive torque delivered to each listed wheel. Entries must sum to one.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:differential:averageWheelSpeedRatios
properties.doc: Weight of each listed wheel when computing the averaged wheel speed fed back to the drivetrain. Entries must sum to one.

classes.name: OpenUsdPhysicsVehicleBrakesAPI
classes.doc: The two independent brake channels of a vehicle. The primary channel is the foot brake and the secondary channel is the hand brake.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:brakes:primaryWheels
properties.doc: Indices of the wheels braked by the primary channel.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:brakes:primaryMaxBrakeTorque
properties.doc: Maximum torque the primary channel applies at full input.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:brakes:primaryTorqueMultipliers
properties.doc: Per-wheel multiplier applied to the primary brake torque, in primary wheel order.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:brakes:secondaryWheels
properties.doc: Indices of the wheels braked by the secondary channel.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:brakes:secondaryMaxBrakeTorque
properties.doc: Maximum torque the secondary channel applies at full input.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:brakes:secondaryTorqueMultipliers
properties.doc: Per-wheel multiplier applied to the secondary brake torque, in secondary wheel order.

classes.name: OpenUsdPhysicsVehicleSteeringAPI
classes.doc: Maps steering input to per-wheel steer angles.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:steering:wheels
properties.doc: Indices of the steered wheels.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:steering:maxSteerAngle
properties.doc: Steer angle in degrees at full steering input.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:steering:angleMultipliers
properties.doc: Per-wheel multiplier applied to the steer angle, in steered wheel order.

classes.name: OpenUsdPhysicsFixedTendon
classes.doc: A fixed tendon coupling articulation joint axes through a linear gearing relation. Modelled as a prim rather than an applied schema so one articulation can carry several tendons.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:fixedTendon:enabled
properties.doc: Enables this tendon.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:fixedTendon:stiffness
properties.doc: Spring stiffness of the tendon length constraint.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:fixedTendon:damping
properties.doc: Damping of the tendon length constraint.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:fixedTendon:limitStiffness
properties.doc: Spring stiffness applied once the tendon length leaves the limit range.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:fixedTendon:offset
properties.doc: Constant added to the geared sum of the joint axis positions.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:fixedTendon:restLength
properties.doc: Tendon length at which the spring applies no force.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:fixedTendon:lowerLimit
properties.doc: Lower bound of the tendon length limit range.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:fixedTendon:upperLimit
properties.doc: Upper bound of the tendon length limit range.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:fixedTendon:gearings
properties.doc: Gearing applied to each joint axis, in the order of the joints relationship.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:fixedTendon:forceCoefficients
properties.doc: Fraction of the tendon force applied to each joint axis, in the order of the joints relationship.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:fixedTendon:articulation
properties.doc: Single articulation root prim the tendon belongs to.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:fixedTendon:rootJoint
properties.doc: Single joint prim closest to the articulation root. Defines the tendon traversal order.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:fixedTendon:joints
properties.doc: Ordered joint prims coupled by this tendon. Each entry pairs with one gearing and one force coefficient.

classes.name: OpenUsdPhysicsSpatialTendon
classes.doc: A spatial tendon constraining distances between attachment points on an articulation. Attachment points carry OpenUsdPhysicsTendonAttachmentAPI.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:spatialTendon:enabled
properties.doc: Enables this tendon.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:spatialTendon:stiffness
properties.doc: Spring stiffness of the tendon length constraint.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:spatialTendon:damping
properties.doc: Damping of the tendon length constraint.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:spatialTendon:limitStiffness
properties.doc: Spring stiffness applied once the tendon length leaves the limit range.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:spatialTendon:offset
properties.doc: Constant added to the accumulated tendon length.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:spatialTendon:articulation
properties.doc: Single articulation root prim the tendon belongs to.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:spatialTendon:rootAttachment
properties.doc: Single prim carrying OpenUsdPhysicsTendonAttachmentAPI with the 'root' role. The remaining attachments are reached through their parent relationships.

classes.name: OpenUsdPhysicsTendonAttachmentAPI
classes.doc: One attachment point of a spatial tendon. Apply to a link prim of the articulation that owns the tendon.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:tendonAttachment:role
properties.doc: Position of this attachment in the tendon tree. Limits and rest length apply to 'leaf' attachments only.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:tendonAttachment:localPosition
properties.doc: Attachment point in the local space of the prim, in stage linear units.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:tendonAttachment:gearing
properties.doc: Gearing applied to the distance between this attachment and its parent.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:tendonAttachment:restLength
properties.doc: Tendon length at which the spring applies no force. Applies to 'leaf' attachments.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:tendonAttachment:lowerLimit
properties.doc: Lower bound of the tendon length limit range. Applies to 'leaf' attachments.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:tendonAttachment:upperLimit
properties.doc: Upper bound of the tendon length limit range. Applies to 'leaf' attachments.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:tendonAttachment:tendon
properties.doc: Single OpenUsdPhysicsSpatialTendon prim this attachment belongs to.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:tendonAttachment:parentAttachment
properties.doc: Single prim carrying the parent attachment. Absent on the 'root' attachment.

classes.name: OpenUsdPhysicsMimicJointAPI
classes.doc: Couples one articulation joint axis to an axis of another joint through a linear gearing relation. Apply to the joint prim that follows the reference.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:mimicJoint:enabled
properties.doc: Enables the coupling.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:mimicJoint:axis
properties.doc: Axis of this joint that follows the reference axis.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:mimicJoint:referenceAxis
properties.doc: Axis of the reference joint that drives this joint.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:mimicJoint:gearing
properties.doc: Ratio between the reference axis position and this axis position.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:mimicJoint:offset
properties.doc: Constant added to the geared reference axis position.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:mimicJoint:naturalFrequency
properties.doc: Natural frequency of the coupling constraint. Zero requests a rigid coupling.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:mimicJoint:dampingRatio
properties.doc: Damping ratio of the coupling constraint. Ignored when the natural frequency is zero.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:mimicJoint:referenceJoint
properties.doc: Single joint prim that drives this joint.

classes.name: OpenUsdPhysicsParticleSystemAPI
classes.doc: A position-based-dynamics particle system that owns particle sets, particle cloth, and fluids. Apply to a prim that represents the system.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:particleSystem:enabled
properties.doc: Enables the particle system.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:particleSystem:contactOffset
properties.doc: Distance at which particle contacts with other objects are generated, in stage linear units. A negative value requests the runtime default.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:particleSystem:restOffset
properties.doc: Separation kept at rest between particles and other objects, in stage linear units. A negative value requests the runtime default.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:particleSystem:particleContactOffset
properties.doc: Distance at which particle-particle contacts are generated, in stage linear units. A negative value requests the runtime default.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:particleSystem:solidRestOffset
properties.doc: Separation kept at rest between two solid particles, in stage linear units. A negative value requests the runtime default.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:particleSystem:fluidRestOffset
properties.doc: Separation kept at rest between two fluid particles, in stage linear units. A negative value requests the runtime default.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:particleSystem:solverPositionIterationCount
properties.doc: Solver position iterations per simulation step for this system.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:particleSystem:maxDepenetrationVelocity
properties.doc: Upper bound on the velocity applied to resolve particle penetration.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:particleSystem:maxNeighborhood
properties.doc: Maximum number of neighbours tracked per particle.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:particleSystem:neighborhoodScale
properties.doc: Scale applied to the particle contact offset when building the neighbourhood.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:particleSystem:wind
properties.doc: Wind velocity applied to the system in stage space, in stage linear units per second.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:particleSystem:globalSelfCollisionEnabled
properties.doc: Enables collisions between particles of different particle groups.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:particleSystem:nonParticleCollisionEnabled
properties.doc: Enables collisions between particles and rigid or deformable geometry.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:particleSystem:enableCCD
properties.doc: Enables continuous collision detection for particles of this system.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:particleSystem:simulationOwner
properties.doc: Single PhysicsScene that simulates this particle system.

classes.name: OpenUsdPhysicsParticleSetAPI
classes.doc: Turns the points of a UsdGeomPointBased prim into simulated particles. Apply alongside the geometry that supplies the points.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:particleSet:enabled
properties.doc: Enables simulation of this particle set.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:particleSet:fluid
properties.doc: Simulates the particles with the fluid constraint model instead of the solid one.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:particleSet:selfCollision
properties.doc: Enables collisions between particles of this set.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:particleSet:particleGroup
properties.doc: Group index used to filter particle-particle collisions.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:particleSet:mass
properties.doc: Total mass of the set in stage mass units. Zero requests a mass derived from the material density and the particle volume.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:particleSet:restPoints
properties.doc: Rest configuration of the particles in local space. When empty the authored geometry points are used.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:particleSet:particleSystem
properties.doc: Single prim carrying OpenUsdPhysicsParticleSystemAPI that owns these particles.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:particleSet:material
properties.doc: Single material prim carrying OpenUsdPhysicsPbdMaterialAPI.

classes.name: OpenUsdPhysicsParticleClothAPI
classes.doc: Simulates a triangulated mesh as position-based-dynamics cloth built from distance springs. Apply alongside the mesh geometry.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:particleCloth:enabled
properties.doc: Enables simulation of this cloth.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:particleCloth:selfCollision
properties.doc: Enables collisions between particles of this cloth.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:particleCloth:selfCollisionFilter
properties.doc: Filters self collisions between particles that share a spring.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:particleCloth:pressure
properties.doc: Inflation pressure for closed meshes. Zero disables the pressure constraint.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:particleCloth:particleGroup
properties.doc: Group index used to filter particle-particle collisions.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:particleCloth:springIndices
properties.doc: Particle index pairs describing the springs, two indices per spring.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:particleCloth:springStiffnesses
properties.doc: Stiffness per spring, in spring order.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:particleCloth:springDampings
properties.doc: Damping per spring, in spring order.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:particleCloth:springRestLengths
properties.doc: Rest length per spring, in spring order and in stage linear units.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:particleCloth:restPoints
properties.doc: Rest configuration of the cloth particles in local space. When empty the authored mesh points are used.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:particleCloth:particleSystem
properties.doc: Single prim carrying OpenUsdPhysicsParticleSystemAPI that owns these particles.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:particleCloth:material
properties.doc: Single material prim carrying OpenUsdPhysicsPbdMaterialAPI.

classes.name: OpenUsdPhysicsPbdMaterialAPI
classes.doc: Material response for position-based-dynamics particles, fluids, and particle cloth. Apply to a UsdShadeMaterial prim.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:pbdMaterial:friction
properties.doc: Friction coefficient between particles and other objects.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:pbdMaterial:particleFrictionScale
properties.doc: Scale applied to the friction coefficient for particle-particle contacts.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:pbdMaterial:damping
properties.doc: Velocity damping applied to the particles.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:pbdMaterial:viscosity
properties.doc: Fluid viscosity. Ignored for solid particles.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:pbdMaterial:vorticityConfinement
properties.doc: Strength of the fluid vorticity confinement term.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:pbdMaterial:surfaceTension
properties.doc: Fluid surface tension.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:pbdMaterial:cohesion
properties.doc: Attraction between particles of the same set.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:pbdMaterial:adhesion
properties.doc: Attraction between particles and other objects.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:pbdMaterial:particleAdhesionScale
properties.doc: Scale applied to the adhesion for particle-particle contacts.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:pbdMaterial:adhesionOffsetScale
properties.doc: Scale applied to the particle contact offset when evaluating adhesion.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:pbdMaterial:gravityScale
properties.doc: Scale applied to scene gravity for these particles.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:pbdMaterial:lift
properties.doc: Aerodynamic lift coefficient applied to particle cloth.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:pbdMaterial:drag
properties.doc: Aerodynamic drag coefficient applied to particle cloth.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:pbdMaterial:density
properties.doc: Particle density in stage mass units per cubic linear unit. Zero requests the runtime default.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:pbdMaterial:cflCoefficient
properties.doc: Courant-Friedrichs-Lewy coefficient limiting the fluid time step.

classes.name: OpenUsdPhysicsDiffuseParticlesAPI
classes.doc: Spray, foam, and bubble particles generated from a fluid particle set. Apply alongside OpenUsdPhysicsParticleSetAPI.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:diffuseParticles:enabled
properties.doc: Enables diffuse particle generation.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:diffuseParticles:maxParticleMultiplier
properties.doc: Upper bound on the diffuse particle count as a multiple of the fluid particle count.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:diffuseParticles:threshold
properties.doc: Weighted potential above which a diffuse particle is spawned.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:diffuseParticles:lifetime
properties.doc: Diffuse particle lifetime in seconds.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:diffuseParticles:airDrag
properties.doc: Drag applied to diffuse particles outside the fluid.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:diffuseParticles:bubbleDrag
properties.doc: Drag applied to diffuse particles inside the fluid.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:diffuseParticles:buoyancy
properties.doc: Buoyancy applied to diffuse particles inside the fluid.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:diffuseParticles:kineticEnergyWeight
properties.doc: Weight of the kinetic energy term in the spawn potential.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:diffuseParticles:pressureWeight
properties.doc: Weight of the pressure term in the spawn potential.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:diffuseParticles:divergenceWeight
properties.doc: Weight of the divergence term in the spawn potential.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:diffuseParticles:collisionDecay
properties.doc: Fraction of the remaining lifetime removed when a diffuse particle collides.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:diffuseParticles:useAccurateVelocity
properties.doc: Advects diffuse particles with the accurate fluid velocity field at a higher cost.

classes.name: OpenUsdPhysicsParticleAnisotropyAPI
classes.doc: Anisotropic shaping of fluid particles for surface reconstruction. Apply alongside OpenUsdPhysicsParticleSystemAPI.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:particleAnisotropy:enabled
properties.doc: Enables anisotropic particle shaping.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:particleAnisotropy:scale
properties.doc: Scale applied to the computed anisotropy.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:particleAnisotropy:min
properties.doc: Lower bound on an anisotropy axis, as a fraction of the particle radius.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:particleAnisotropy:max
properties.doc: Upper bound on an anisotropy axis, as a fraction of the particle radius.

classes.name: OpenUsdPhysicsParticleSmoothingAPI
classes.doc: Laplacian smoothing of fluid particle positions used for surface reconstruction. Apply alongside OpenUsdPhysicsParticleSystemAPI.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:particleSmoothing:enabled
properties.doc: Enables position smoothing.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:particleSmoothing:strength
properties.doc: Smoothing strength between zero and one.

classes.name: OpenUsdPhysicsParticleIsosurfaceAPI
classes.doc: Isosurface extraction settings for a fluid particle system. Apply alongside OpenUsdPhysicsParticleSystemAPI.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:isosurface:enabled
properties.doc: Enables isosurface extraction.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:isosurface:maxVertices
properties.doc: Upper bound on the extracted vertex count.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:isosurface:maxTriangles
properties.doc: Upper bound on the extracted triangle count.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:isosurface:maxSubgrids
properties.doc: Upper bound on the number of sparse grid blocks used during extraction.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:isosurface:gridSpacing
properties.doc: Extraction grid cell size in stage linear units.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:isosurface:surfaceDistance
properties.doc: Distance from a particle centre at which the surface is placed, in stage linear units.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:isosurface:gridFilteringPasses
properties.doc: Ordered grid filter passes. Each character selects one pass: 's' smooth, 'g' grow, 'r' reduce.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:isosurface:gridSmoothingRadius
properties.doc: Radius of the grid smoothing kernel in stage linear units.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:isosurface:numMeshSmoothingPasses
properties.doc: Smoothing passes applied to the extracted mesh positions.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:isosurface:numMeshNormalSmoothingPasses
properties.doc: Smoothing passes applied to the extracted mesh normals.

classes.name: OpenUsdPhysicsSurfaceDeformableAPI
classes.doc: Simulates a triangulated mesh as a surface deformable solved on its own vertices. Apply alongside the mesh geometry.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:surfaceDeformable:enabled
properties.doc: Enables simulation of this surface deformable.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:surfaceDeformable:solverPositionIterationCount
properties.doc: Solver position iterations per simulation step.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:surfaceDeformable:vertexVelocityDamping
properties.doc: Velocity damping applied to the simulated vertices.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:surfaceDeformable:selfCollision
properties.doc: Enables collisions between parts of this surface.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:surfaceDeformable:selfCollisionFilterDistance
properties.doc: Rest distance below which self collisions are filtered, in stage linear units.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:surfaceDeformable:collisionPairUpdateFrequency
properties.doc: Simulation steps between two collision pair rebuilds.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:surfaceDeformable:collisionIterationMultiplier
properties.doc: Collision iterations performed per solver position iteration.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:surfaceDeformable:maxDisplacement
properties.doc: Upper bound on the distance a vertex may move in one step, in stage linear units. Zero disables the clamp.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:surfaceDeformable:enableCCD
properties.doc: Enables continuous collision detection for this surface.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:surfaceDeformable:restPoints
properties.doc: Rest configuration of the simulated vertices in local space. When empty the authored mesh points are used.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:surfaceDeformable:simulationIndices
properties.doc: Triangle indices of the simulated surface, three indices per triangle. When empty the authored mesh topology is used.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:surfaceDeformable:simulationOwner
properties.doc: Single PhysicsScene that simulates this surface deformable.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:surfaceDeformable:material
properties.doc: Single material prim carrying OpenUsdPhysicsSurfaceDeformableMaterialAPI.

classes.name: OpenUsdPhysicsSurfaceDeformableMaterialAPI
classes.doc: Material response for surface deformables. Apply to a UsdShadeMaterial prim.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:surfaceDeformableMaterial:density
properties.doc: Material density in stage mass units per cubic linear unit.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:surfaceDeformableMaterial:youngsModulus
properties.doc: Stretch resistance of the surface.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:surfaceDeformableMaterial:poissonsRatio
properties.doc: Transverse contraction under stretch, between zero and one half.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:surfaceDeformableMaterial:dynamicFriction
properties.doc: Friction coefficient against other objects.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:surfaceDeformableMaterial:thickness
properties.doc: Simulated shell thickness in stage linear units.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:surfaceDeformableMaterial:bendingStiffness
properties.doc: Resistance to bending across shared edges.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:surfaceDeformableMaterial:elasticityDamping
properties.doc: Damping applied to the stretch response.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:surfaceDeformableMaterial:bendingDamping
properties.doc: Damping applied to the bending response.

classes.name: OpenUsdPhysicsVolumeDeformableAPI
classes.doc: Simulates a closed mesh as a finite-element volume deformable driven by a tetrahedral simulation mesh. Apply alongside the render geometry.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:volumeDeformable:enabled
properties.doc: Enables simulation of this volume deformable.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:volumeDeformable:solverPositionIterationCount
properties.doc: Solver position iterations per simulation step.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:volumeDeformable:vertexVelocityDamping
properties.doc: Velocity damping applied to the simulation mesh vertices.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:volumeDeformable:sleepThreshold
properties.doc: Mass-normalized kinetic energy below which the body may sleep.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:volumeDeformable:settlingThreshold
properties.doc: Mass-normalized kinetic energy below which the body starts accumulating sleep time.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:volumeDeformable:selfCollision
properties.doc: Enables collisions between parts of this volume.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:volumeDeformable:selfCollisionFilterDistance
properties.doc: Rest distance below which self collisions are filtered, in stage linear units.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:volumeDeformable:enableCCD
properties.doc: Enables continuous collision detection for this volume.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:volumeDeformable:maxDepenetrationVelocity
properties.doc: Upper bound on the velocity applied to resolve penetration.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:volumeDeformable:kinematicEnabled
properties.doc: Drives the simulation mesh from the authored animation instead of the solver.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:volumeDeformable:simulationHexahedralResolution
properties.doc: Resolution of the voxel grid used to build a simulation mesh when none is authored.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:volumeDeformable:simulationRestPoints
properties.doc: Rest positions of the tetrahedral simulation mesh vertices in local space.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:volumeDeformable:simulationIndices
properties.doc: Tetrahedron indices of the simulation mesh, four indices per tetrahedron.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:volumeDeformable:collisionRestPoints
properties.doc: Rest positions of the collision mesh vertices in local space. When empty the simulation mesh is used for collision.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:volumeDeformable:collisionIndices
properties.doc: Tetrahedron indices of the collision mesh, four indices per tetrahedron.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:volumeDeformable:simulationOwner
properties.doc: Single PhysicsScene that simulates this volume deformable.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:volumeDeformable:material
properties.doc: Single material prim carrying OpenUsdPhysicsVolumeDeformableMaterialAPI.

classes.name: OpenUsdPhysicsVolumeDeformableMaterialAPI
classes.doc: Material response for finite-element volume deformables. Apply to a UsdShadeMaterial prim.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:volumeDeformableMaterial:density
properties.doc: Material density in stage mass units per cubic linear unit.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:volumeDeformableMaterial:youngsModulus
properties.doc: Resistance to deformation of the volume.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:volumeDeformableMaterial:poissonsRatio
properties.doc: Transverse contraction under stretch, between zero and one half.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:volumeDeformableMaterial:dynamicFriction
properties.doc: Friction coefficient against other objects.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:volumeDeformableMaterial:damping
properties.doc: Damping applied to the elastic response.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:volumeDeformableMaterial:dampingScale
properties.doc: Scale applied to the damping term.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:volumeDeformableMaterial:elasticityDamping
properties.doc: Damping proportional to the elastic strain rate.

classes.name: OpenUsdPhysicsAttachment
classes.doc: Attaches two simulated actors to each other. Modelled as a prim so one actor can take part in several attachments.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:attachment:enabled
properties.doc: Enables this attachment.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:attachment:attachmentType
properties.doc: How the attachment points bind to each actor.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:attachment:points0
properties.doc: Attachment points in the local space of the first actor, in stage linear units.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:attachment:points1
properties.doc: Attachment points in the local space of the second actor, paired with the first actor points.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:attachment:elementIndices0
properties.doc: Element index bound by each attachment point on the first actor. Empty selects vertex binding.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:attachment:elementIndices1
properties.doc: Element index bound by each attachment point on the second actor. Empty selects vertex binding.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:attachment:collisionFilterIndices0
properties.doc: Elements or vertices of the first actor excluded from collision with the second actor.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:attachment:collisionFilterIndices1
properties.doc: Elements or vertices of the second actor excluded from collision with the first actor.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:attachment:filterType0
properties.doc: How the first collision filter index list is interpreted.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:attachment:filterType1
properties.doc: How the second collision filter index list is interpreted.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:attachment:stiffness
properties.doc: Spring stiffness of the attachment constraint. Zero requests a rigid attachment.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:attachment:damping
properties.doc: Damping of the attachment constraint. Ignored when the stiffness is zero.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:attachment:actor0
properties.doc: Single first actor prim. May be a rigid body, a surface deformable, a volume deformable, or a particle object.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:attachment:actor1
properties.doc: Single second actor prim. May be a rigid body, a surface deformable, a volume deformable, or a particle object.

classes.name: OpenUsdPhysicsAutoAttachmentAPI
classes.doc: Derives the attachment points and collision filters of an OpenUsdPhysicsAttachment from the overlap of its two actors. Apply to the attachment prim.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:autoAttachment:enabled
properties.doc: Enables automatic generation. Authored attachment points are replaced when this is on.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:autoAttachment:enableDeformableVertexAttachments
properties.doc: Generates attachments at deformable vertices that overlap the other actor.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:autoAttachment:deformableVertexOverlapOffset
properties.doc: Distance added to the overlap test for deformable vertices, in stage linear units.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:autoAttachment:enableRigidSurfaceAttachments
properties.doc: Generates attachments by sampling the surface of a rigid actor.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:autoAttachment:rigidSurfaceSamplingDistance
properties.doc: Spacing of the rigid surface samples in stage linear units. Zero requests a spacing derived from the geometry.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:autoAttachment:enableCollisionFiltering
properties.doc: Generates collision filters for the attached regions.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:autoAttachment:collisionFilteringOffset
properties.doc: Distance added to the region used to generate collision filters, in stage linear units.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:autoAttachment:enableDeformableFilteringPairs
properties.doc: Generates element-level filter pairs when both actors are deformable.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:autoAttachment:maskShapes
properties.doc: Geometry prims that restrict where attachments may be generated.

classes.name: OpenUsdPhysicsCollisionFilterSettingsAPI
classes.doc: Collision filtering that standard UsdPhysicsFilteredPairsAPI and UsdPhysicsCollisionGroup do not express, including element-level filtering for deformables and particles.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:collisionFilter:enabled
properties.doc: Enables the filters declared here.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:collisionFilter:pairFilterMode
properties.doc: How the filtered pairs and filter indices are interpreted.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:collisionFilter:filterIndices
properties.doc: Vertex or element indices on this prim excluded from collision with the filtered pairs.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:collisionFilter:invertFilteredGroups
properties.doc: Treats the filtered groups as the only groups this object may collide with.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:collisionFilter:mergeGroupName
properties.doc: Objects sharing a non-empty merge group name never collide with each other.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:collisionFilter:filteredPairs
properties.doc: Prims this object must not collide with.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:collisionFilter:filterGroups
properties.doc: UsdPhysicsCollisionGroup prims this object must not collide with, or may only collide with when the groups are inverted.

classes.name: OpenUsdPhysicsCookedDataAPI
classes.doc: References cached cooked collision data produced at build time so a session does not have to cook geometry while loading. Apply alongside a collider.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:cookedData:enabled
properties.doc: Enables the cooked data reference.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:cookedData:format
properties.doc: Kind of cooked data referenced here.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:cookedData:assetPath
properties.doc: Path of the cooked data asset, resolved against the layer that authored this opinion.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:cookedData:assetSubIdentifier
properties.doc: Entry inside the cooked data asset. Empty selects the only entry.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:cookedData:contentHash
properties.doc: Hash of the source geometry and cooking parameters the cached data was produced from. A mismatch invalidates the cache.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:cookedData:buildRevision
properties.doc: Opaque revision of the tool that produced the cooked data.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:cookedData:missingDataBehavior
properties.doc: What the session does when the cooked data is absent or its content hash does not match.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:cookedData:sdfResolution
properties.doc: Grid resolution along the longest bounding box axis for the 'sdf' format.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:cookedData:sdfSubgridResolution
properties.doc: Sparse block resolution for the 'sdf' format. Zero requests a dense grid.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:cookedData:sdfNarrowBandThickness
properties.doc: Thickness of the narrow band kept around the surface, as a fraction of the longest bounding box axis.

properties.name: openUsdPhysics:cookedData:sdfBitsPerSubgridPixel
properties.doc: Storage precision of one sparse grid sample for the 'sdf' format.
